description: Add a remote MCP server to your Besidka connectors by address. The connector is created switched off and not signed in: this tool takes no keys or headers, makes no request to the address and cannot switch it on. The user must connect, give consent and enable it in Besidka, at the manageUrl in the result. At most five connectors added this way can wait switched off. Requires signing in (connectors:write).

presetId.description: The id of one of the curated connectors in Besidka, instead of url

title.description: A display name, up to 80 characters. Defaults to the preset name or the host

url.description: The https address of the remote MCP server. Not needed when presetId is set

name: add_connector
title: Add a connector
